title: Odd and even numbers in pairs
examples: How do I know if a number is odd or even?

explain.say: Imagine children lining up in pairs for lunch. If everyone has a partner, the number is even. Look at the board: 8 dots in 2 rows of 4. Every dot has a partner, so 8 is even.

draw.text: Odd and even numbers in pairs

explain.say: Let us make the pairs clear: 4 groups of 2 make 8. Nobody is left out, so 8 is even. Even means it splits into pairs with none left over. What about 7?
With 7, one child has no partner. A number with one left over is odd. Look at the two groups on the board: even numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and odd numbers 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Can you see they take turns?
Here is a secret: just look at the last digit. If it ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8, the number is even, however big it is. 58 ends in 8, so it is even. Is 315 odd or even?
Brilliant! 10 is 2 rows of 5, so it is even. Wow: odd plus odd always makes even, like 3 plus 5 is 8. Challenge: is the number of your fingers and toes together odd or even?

faq.a: An even number splits into pairs with none left over, like 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. It always ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
An odd number has one left over when you make pairs, like 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. It always ends in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9.

faq.q: How do I know if a big number is odd or even?
faq.a: Only look at the last digit, the ones. 3,458 ends in 8, so it is even. 921 ends in 1, so it is odd.
asks: How do I know if a number is odd or even?

faq.a: Yes. Zero makes pairs with none left over, and it sits between the odd numbers 1 and minus 1. So 0 is even.

faq.q: What happens when I add odd and even numbers?
faq.a: Even plus even is even, odd plus odd is even, and odd plus even is odd. For example, 3 plus 5 is 8, but 3 plus 4 is 7.

facts: Every even number ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
The sum of two odd numbers is always even.

quiz.say: What is 5 plus 7, and is it odd or even?
quiz.show: What is 5 + 7, and is it odd or even?
quiz.why: 5 plus 7 is 12, which ends in 2, so it is even. Odd plus odd is always even.
